scope: Same-panel revalidation on three dates of one public PG89 custom preventive DC-SCUC model; numerical solver bounds, not exact independent dual proofs

runtime.toolchain: GCC 14.2, CMake 4.4.3, Ninja, Release/shared, HIPO=OFF, HIGHSINT64=OFF
runtime.hardware_scope: Own cloud environment recovered 2026-10-02; 9 visible logical CPUs and about 9.7 GiB memory, no guaranteed dedicated quota

policy.common_options:
threads = 2
parallel = off
presolve = on
write_solution_to_file = true
write_solution_style = 0
log_dev_level = 1
highs_analysis_level = 128
mip_rel_gap = 0.01
mip_improving_solution_save = false
mip_lp_solver = choose
mip_ipm_solver = choose
mip_heuristic_outer_gap = true
mip_heuristic_outer_gap_log = true
mip_initial_root_ipx = false
mip_heuristic_near_target_root_budget = false
mip_heuristic_near_target_root_budget_log = true
policy.repair_scope_clarification: No external repair, LP-screening, constructive seed, start/basis/state or incumbent/bound carry. Ordinary internal HiGHS repair remains solver behavior and includes the reviewed #3181 correction.

clock_boundaries.solver_process_wall: Measured whole solver process launch/import/optimization/output through exact reap; nested work counted once; requested solver timer is not the debit
clock_boundaries.complete_process_e2e: Per-arm containing-process Popen through exact wait4 reap, including child startup, full verification, generation/readback, every solve, complete independent checking and durable arm output
clock_boundaries.excluded_controller_work: Redundant controller-only prelaunch integrity/health checks, supervision setup before its timer, inter-arm archival/statistical writes, and final campaign reporting
clock_boundaries.operator_bookkeeping: Outside the primary endpoints, observation/checkpoint convenience wrappers were added after pair 2; they invoke the unchanged pair CLI and offline verifier and retain scalar checkpoints

prospective_stop_rule.authority: Prospectively fixed on 2026-10-02 before corrected-runtime outcomes; execute all nine fixed pairs after clean complete or clean censored/incomplete arms, stopping dependent execution on fatal integrity/resource/cancellation/cleanup failure

schedule_provenance.authority: Published executable consumer_launch.arm_order, explicit dates/seeds/sequence/arm-order rules
schedule_provenance.limitation: Original raw predeclared schedule/stop predicate unavailable after workspace loss. Published executable order is verified; identity to unseen original predicate is not claimed.

fixed_criteria: All nine pairs eligible and strictly faster on both endpoints; each date median paired reduction at least 30% on both endpoints

limitations: Known official defects addressed in a custom reference; not universal solver correctness or an exact dual proof
#3181 attachment compatibility passed, but all four runs reported Repair LPs=0, so dynamic repair-branch coverage was not established
Original dates and seeds were already exposed; this is same-panel revalidation, not a new untouched holdout
Three seeds per date and one topology do not establish broad reliability or a distributional tail guarantee
No larger-case speedup or general MILP kernel speedup is established
Original raw stop predicate unavailable after workspace loss; published order was verified and the prospective full-panel rule frozen before these runs
